input=document.getElementById('relationship-search'),list=document.getElementById('relationship-results');function hide(){list.style.display='none'}function update(){const tokens=input.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('ru').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);list.replaceChildren();if(!tokens.length){hide();return}const hits=data.filter(x=>tokens.every(t=>x.label.toLocaleLowerCase('ru').includes(t))).slice(0,8);for(const row of hits){const b=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml','button');b.type='button';b.textContent=row.label;b.style.cssText='display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:white;border:0;border-top:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;font:26px Arial;cursor:pointer';b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const path=document.getElementById('path-'+row.id);if(path)path.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}));hide()});list.appendChild(b)}if(!hits.length){const n=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml','div');n.textContent='Совпадений нет';list.appendChild(n)}list.style.display='block'}input.addEventListener('input',update);input.addEventListener('focus',update);document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){hide();input.blur()}})})();
